title: Backscatter Pedestrian
text: 来自行人的后向散射信号，输入 3 路、输出 4 路；{Height (m)} 指定行人高度、{Walking Speed (m/s)} 指定行人行走速度 1.4 times pedestrian、{Propagation speed (m/s)} 指定信号传播速度 physconst、{Operating Frequency (Hz)} 指定载波频率 300e6、{Initial Position (m)} 指定行人的初始位置、{Initial Heading (deg)} 指定行人的初始航向、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 入射雷达信号 complex-valued M -by-16 matrix

ports.name: Ang
ports.summary: 入射信号方向 real-valued 2-by-16 matrix

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: 合并后的反射雷达信号 complex-valued M -by-1 column vector

ports.name: Pos
ports.summary: 身体分段位置 real-valued 3-by-16 matrix

ports.name: Vel
ports.summary: 身体分段速度 real-valued 3-by-16 matrix

ports.name: Ax
ports.summary: 身体分段方位 real-valued 3-by-3-by-16 array

params.name: Walking Speed (m/s)
params.values: 行人行走速度 1.4 times pedestrian height (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: 信号传播速度 physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial Position (m)
params.values: 行人的初始位置 [0;0;0] (default) | 3-by-1 real-valued vector

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
